stemMd: Four cards show 2, 3, 4 and 5. Two different cards are chosen and multiplied. How many distinct products are possible?
explanationMd: The unordered pairs produce 6, 8, 10, 12, 15 and 20. There are six pairs and no product repeats, so there are six distinct products. Listing values checks the distinctness requirement rather than assuming it.

distractorRationale.b: All six pair products are different in this set.
distractorRationale.d: This includes more products than the six unordered pairs.
distractorRationale.e: This counts reversed orderings of the same two cards separately.
